verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an HR/payroll/PEO platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no documented capability to export all company data in open formats (such as CSV or JSON) for leaving the service. The Analytics > Custom Payroll Report is a viewing/checking feature with no stated export format, and the Xero sync is an accounting integration, so neither establishes a full open-format exit path; the probes also found no published API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
